## Restaurant Brands International Inc. Closes Inaugural Investment Grade-Rated Senior Secured Notes Offering


Company Release - 11/24/2026 4:30 PM ET


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


*$1 Billion Offering Includes $500 Million of Senior Secured Notes Due 2031 and* *$500 Million Due 2036* *Proceeds Used to Repay a Portion of RBI's Existing Term Loan B Facility*


MIAMI


, Nov. 24, 2026


/CNW/ -- Restaurant Brands International Inc. ("RBI") (NYSE: QSR) (TSX: QSR) (TSX: QSP), announced today the completion of a public offering (the "Offering") of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 6.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (the "2031 Notes") and $500 million aggregate principal amount of 6.40% Senior Secured Notes due 2036 (together with the 2031 Notes, the "Notes").


"Closing our debut Investment Grade-rated notes offering marks an important milestone for RBI as we simplify our business," said Sami Siddiqui, Chief Financial Officer of RBI. "We are on track to reach the leverage targets outlined during our investor day. We appreciate the support from our credit investors on this offering and look forward to building on these relationships in the years ahead."


The Notes were co-issued by 1011778 B.C. Unlimited Liability Company and New Red Finance, Inc. (collectively, the "Issuers"), each a wholly-owned subsidiary of RBI. The Issuers used the net proceeds from the Offering to repay a portion of the outstanding borrowings under RBI's existing term loan B facility and to pay related fees and expenses.


The Offering was made pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on November 16, 2026, including a prospectus dated November 16, 2026 and the related final prospectus supplement dated November 17, 2026. These documents are available free of charge by visiting EDGAR on the SEC website at[www.sec.gov](http://www.sec.gov/) .


This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell, or the solicitation of an offer to buy, the Notes or any other security. No offer, solicitation, purchase or sale will be made in any jurisdiction in which such an offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful.


**About Restaurant Brands International**


Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with over $49 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories. RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands - TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.
